code:
from torch.sparse import to_sparse_semi_structured
import torch

# mask: exactly 2 of every 4 contiguous weights are zero
weight.data = (weight.data * mask).contiguous()
sparse_weight = to_sparse_semi_structured(weight.data)

# layer now runs on Ampere+ sparse tensor cores
linear.weight = torch.nn.Parameter(sparse_weight)
caption: N:M sparsity needs this exact fixed pattern to engage dedicated sparse hardware — scattered zeros don't qualify.
